# Cuteness meter · just for fun

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/cuteness-meter/

Make a playful photo score card with a camera or uploaded image. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Take a selfie or choose a pet photo, then create a bright entertainment-only score card.

## Limits and checks

Scores are playful and randomized, not an analysis of appearance or a scientific beauty measurement. The photo stays on your device.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
